note: Internal ACE/ICE knowledge base for closing script generation

items.title: Diagnostic Frame Opener
items.content: Before we start, quick expectation-set: this isn't a pitch call. It's diagnostic. I'll ask questions, you share context, and we'll both know if this is a fit or not. Sound good?

items.title: Pipeline Unpredictable - Dig
items.content: Walk me through your current client acquisition. Where does it start, where does it break? And what's the real cost of this unpredictability - not just money, but stress, team morale?

items.title: Budget Anchor - ROI Math
items.content: Let's math it out: if we add even 2-3 clients at your ticket size of ₹{ticket}, ROI is {roi_multiple}x. So the question isn't 'can I afford this?' - it's 'can I afford NOT to fix the pipeline?'

items.title: Budget Tight
items.content: I hear you. Let me ask: is it *tight*, or is it *not a priority*? Because if pipeline is the bottleneck, this should be priority #1, no?

items.title: Need to Think
items.content: Totally fair. What specifically do you need to think about? Budget, timing, fit? And if you think for 2 weeks, what will have changed?

items.title: Already Tried Coaching
items.content: Got it. What didn't work last time? Strategy or execution? Here's the difference: most coaches give you a plan. We give you plan + AI Agents System to execute it.

items.title: Results Guarantee
items.content: I can't guarantee results - no ethical consultant can. What I *can* guarantee: you'll have working ICE setup, funnel live, qualified leads. Closing them is on you. Fair?

items.title: Assumptive Close
items.content: Alright, so here's next step: I'll send you the agreement. Review, sign, and we kick off next week. First milestone: ICE gate setup in 7 days. You in?

items.title: Choice Close
items.content: Two ways forward: (1) Full ICE setup (₹{full_price}), or (2) Just gate + drip (₹{lower_price}), you handle rest. Which makes more sense?

items.title: Urgency Close
items.content: I'm holding your slot till EOD Friday. After that, it rolls to next prospect. If you're serious, now's the time. If not, we can reconnect later. Your call.

items.title: ICE Nurturing Explained
items.content: ICE Nurturing is WhatsApp drip that pre-sells before the call. By the time they book, they're 70% convinced. It's not 'follow-up' - it's strategic value delivery + belief building.

items.title: ICE Auto-Qualification
items.content: ICE scores applicants on PAIN/BUDGET/TIMELINE/FIT. Threshold is 70. Above that = qualified. Below = nurture or reject. It's doctor-frame: we accept/reject, not chase everyone.

items.title: ICE Payment Automation
items.content: Post-call payment follow-ups: (1) Immediate (5 min), (2) Reminder (2 hours), (3) Urgency (24 hours). Automated, personalized, includes payment link. Closes deals while you sleep.

items.title: ProofLoop System
items.content: ProofLoop turns every client into proof asset: Feedback → Bonus → Wall → Ads. Drip automates collection. Bonus incentivizes quality. Wall compounds trust. Part of Traffic & Trust Engine.

items.title: Bonus Strategy
items.content: Offer high-value bonus (₹2-5k perceived value) for 5-star testimonial. Instant delivery. Makes asking easy, receiving exciting. Testimonial = social proof asset worth 10x bonus cost.

items.title: Search Harvest
items.content: Capture high-intent searches on Google/YouTube/LinkedIn. Keyword: '[problem] solution', '[niche] consultant', etc. Gate = HVCO (₹499 GrowthMap). Pre-qualified traffic.

items.title: Piggyback Strategy
items.content: Target competitor audiences. Example: 'If you tried [competitor] and it didn't work, here's why...' Differentiation messaging. Retargeting on proof content.

items.title: Partner Taps
items.content: Collaborate with adjacent service providers. Example: CAs refer clients to business coaches, get 10% commission. Warm intros, pre-qualified, high trust.
